title.narrative: P93 - Reducing Biological risks by strengthening Public Health Laboratories - STRONGLABS_2.0

description.narrative: Contract inherited from multiple actions, related to: P93 - Reducing Biological risks by strengthening Public Health Laboratories - STRONGLABS_2.0 - This action will contribute to achieving the three specific objectives as set out in the multiannual indicative programme: 1.      Improved detection of and mitigation against risks related to CBRN materials or agents and risks related to installations or sites through the EU CBRN Centres of Excellence Initiative and associated actions.2.      Enhanced capacities on strategic trade controls of dual-use goods.3.      Promote a culture of safety and responsible science and engineering.
